name: Data Quality Gate
description: Check an entire original lead, order or inventory file against an approved contract before downstream writes.
default_downstream_policy: continue only; forward exact checked original bytes
approval: explicit versioned contract and optional baseline hash approval
auth: verified organization API key; browser session uses CSRF protections

billing.unit: completed full-file supported evaluation, including block/warning

scope: explicit rules only; no repair/remapping or independent business-meaning verification
